description: Online char-LSTM + 32-bit Witten-Neal-Cleary arithmetic coder. Non-cmix neural compression. Pure numpy + Python stdlib, no torch, no pretrained weights. Encoder/decoder run identical SGD-updated LSTM in lockstep for bit-exact roundtrip.

notes: Diagnostic v1 establishing the non-cmix lane. Architecture: 1-layer LSTM, H=128, E=32, char-level. Per-step SGD only (no BPTT) — long-term memory comes from carried (h,c). Weights PRNG-seeded (SEED=0x5EED), zero archive cost, regenerated identically on decompress. Predicted enwik9 entropy: 2.0-2.4 b/B → 250-300 MB at full corpus. NOT a fx2-cmix challenger at this size. Throughput: pure-numpy LSTM step is sequential and ~3 matmuls + ~3 outer products per byte; 1 MB scope is tractable, 10 MB scope and beyond is bottlenecked on per-step Python overhead. v2 plans: add BPTT-K=8, second LSTM layer, raise H to 256. v3 plans: int-quant arithmetic for strict cross-host parity (current fp32 numpy is bit-exact same-host single-thread but may differ across CPU archs).
